operating_notes.text: Renewable loan book increased to ₹75,347 crore as on March 31, 2026, reflecting 30% growth.
Loan book stood at an all-time high of ₹5.84 lakh crore as on March 31, 2026, up around ₹17,000 crore during the year.
Sanctions were ₹4,09,097 crore in FY26 against ₹3,37,179 crore, up 21%.
RECPDCL incorporated Bhadla Ramgarh Power Transmission Limited, Lakadia II Power Transmission Limited, and Jam Khambhaliya Jamnagar Power Transmission Limited as wholly owned subsidiaries.

RECPDCL transferred 100% of Hampapura Power Transmission Limited (to Resonia Limited, ₹8.61 Cr including taxes) and Mekhali Power Transmission Limited (to Dilip Buildcon Limited, ₹8.06 Cr including taxes) at par.
Received No Objection Certificate from RBI for the proposed scheme of merger with and into Power Finance Corporation Limited.
RECPDCL transferred 100% of Nawada Durgapur Power Transmission Limited to Shivalaya Construction Limited for ₹18.45 Cr including taxes.
RBI classified REC as an Upper Layer Non-Banking Financial Company (UL-NBFC).

timeline.summary: On May 9, 2026, REC Limited announced through its subsidiary RECPDCL the incorporation of three wholly owned SPVs for inter-state power transmission projects.
On May 16, 2026, REC Limited announced that its board reserved the proposal for its merger into Power Finance Corporation for the President of India's approval.
On October 15, 2026, REC Limited announced the receipt of a No Objection Certificate from the Reserve Bank of India for its proposed merger into Power Finance Corporation Limited.
On October 16, 2026, REC Limited's subsidiary RECPDCL completed the sale of Nawada Durgapur Power Transmission Limited to Shivalaya Construction Limited for ₹18.45 crore.
REC Limited's subsidiary incorporates three wholly owned SPVs for transmission projects
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹15,000.4 Cr (-1.0% YoY), net profit ₹3,477.73 Cr (-21.2% YoY).
